hypothesis: A bounded smoke run should prove the complete training, checkpoint, metric, and evidence pipeline before expensive training.
notes: Diagnostic only; metrics are intentionally ineligible because only bounded batches are evaluated.

hypothesis: ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-18 should provide a strong accuracy-first reference on resized grayscale faces.
notes: No augmentation; ImageNet normalization; accuracy-first checkpoint selection.

hypothesis: Mild label smoothing may improve validation accuracy by reducing overconfidence on ambiguous FER labels.
notes: Single-variable comparison against r01: label smoothing 0.05.

hypothesis: Conservative grayscale-safe geometric and intensity augmentation should improve accuracy without cropping away facial regions.
notes: Single-variable comparison against r01: conservative augmentation only; smoothing excluded after r02 underperformed.

hypothesis: Training-partition grayscale normalization may transfer better than ImageNet RGB normalization despite the pretrained RGB backbone.
notes: Single-variable comparison against r01: training-only grayscale mean/std instead of ImageNet normalization.
